STATUS EPILEPTICUS 
ANTICONVULSANT ALGORITHM 
 
 
 
ABORT SEIZURE 
FIRST LINE AGENTS - BENZODIAZEPINE 
 
• Lorazepam  (AtivanÒ)  0.1 mg/kg IV    (max rate 2mg/min) 
• Diazepam (ValiumÒ)  0.2 – 0.3 mg/kg IV  (max rate 5mg/min) 
• Clonazepam (RivotrilÒ) 0.02 mg/kg IV 
• Midazolam (DormicumÒ) 0.2 mg/kg IV  
0.3 mg/kg buccal / intranasal 
 
** If the seizure continues, administer a 2nd dose of the chosen benzodiazepine 
LOAD WITH A SECOND LINE ANTICONVULSANT 
 
• Phenytoin  20 mg/kg IV  (max rate 50 mg/min) 
• Sodium Valproate 20 - 30 mg/kg IV (max rate 3-6 mg/kg/min) 
• Phenobarbitone 20 mg/kg IV   
 
IF SEIZURE CONTINUES 
IF SEIZURE TERMINATES 
LOAD WITH A 2nd 
LINE 
ANTICONVULSANT 
IF SEIZURE CONTINUES 
REPEAT 2ND LINE ANTICONVULSANT after 20 minutes 
 
• Phenytoin  10 mg/kg IV  (max rate 50 mg/min) 
• Sodium Valproate 10 mg/kg IV  (max rate 3-6 mg/kg/min) 
• Phenobarbitone 10 mg/kg   
 
IF SEIZURE CONTINUES 
REFRACTORY STATUS EPILEPTICUS 
THIRD LINE ANTICONVULSANT 
 
• Midazolam (DormicumÒ) Loading Dose 0.2 mg/kg IV then 
Infusion 0.1 mg/kg/hr (0.05 - 2mg/kg/hr) 
• Propofol   Loading dose 3 – 5 mg/kg IV then 
Infusion 1 – 15 mg/kg/hr 
• Ketamine   Loading dose 1.5 mg/kg then 
Infusion 0.01 – 0.05 mg/kg/hr 
Dr R Gihwala CMJAH Emergency Department June 2020
